headline: Apple raises the MacBook Neo’s student pricing again
summary: Apple hiked the MacBook Neo's student price to $649. This marks a $150 increase from its initial $499 education price. The budget MacBook is now only $50 cheaper than the standard model.

headline: xAI is buying out homeowners who promise not to sue over data center noise
summary: Elon Musk's xAI is offering to buy homes in a Mississippi neighborhood. The offer is contingent on residents not suing over data center noise. This move aims to prevent lawsuits targeting xAI's nearby power plant.

headline: Here’s Virgin Galactic’s new Apeiron spaceship
summary: Virgin Galactic unveiled its new Delta-class spaceship, named 'Apeiron' by public vote. Apeiron is not expected to launch for nearly another year. The company also announced further delays for its first commercial spaceflight.

headline: This is how badly X wants you to pay to promote your posts
summary: X is now using an animated arm to push users to promote their posts. This aggressive tactic follows Elon Musk's warning to advertisers. X is clearly prioritizing promoting content visibility.

headline: Dexter: Resurrection Season 2 Premiere Review
summary: Dexter returns in the Resurrection Season 2 premiere, tired of his mundane life. He decides to shake things up on the serial killer side of things. The review covers his return to form.

headline: The Division Franchise Hits 50 Million Players as Division 3 Develops
summary: The Division series celebrates its 10th anniversary with over 50 million players. Ubisoft confirms The Division 3 is actively in development. This milestone highlights the franchise's enduring popularity.

headline: How Does LEGO PlayStation Compare to the Actual Console?
summary: A comparison shows the LEGO PlayStation alongside the original console. The article examines how the brick version stacks up. It provides a side-by-side look at the two designs.

headline: Valve 'Thinking About How to Solve' Steam's AI Slop Problem, but Won't Limit Developer Access
summary: Valve acknowledges Steam's growing issue with AI-generated "slop games". The company is exploring solutions but won't restrict developer access. This addresses concerns about low-quality AI content flooding the platform.

headline: Key Points from Chancellor John Healey’s First Budget
summary: Chancellor John Healey delivered his first government Budget. The Budget outlines the government's tax and spending plans. This summary highlights the most important details at a glance.

headline: How the New Budget Affects Your Finances
summary: Chancellor John Healey's first Budget introduces direct financial changes. The article details how these changes will impact personal finances. Understand the direct implications of the new policies.

headline: Chancellor Delivers First Budget for 'Working People of Britain'
summary: The Chancellor began his inaugural Budget speech. He declared it a Budget for the "working people of Britain" and "British businesses." This marks his first major financial address to the nation.

headline: Dozens Feared Dead in High-Speed Train Crash South of Madrid
summary: A high-speed train collided with another train near Madrid. Dozens of casualties are feared following the accident. Emergency services are at the scene with overturned carriages and makeshift medical tents.
